title_patterns_that_work: Directly questioning legitimacy using 'Legit' or 'Scam' with parenthetical context
Using action-oriented verification phrases like '(I Checked)' or '(Proof Inside)'
Capitalizing on trending or high-curiosity consumer apps and platforms
title_patterns_to_avoid: Vague framing without mentioning specific brands or apps
Overly lengthy titles that lose the core value proposition before truncation
Generic curiosity gaps that lack immediate relevance to consumer trust
notes: Shorts significantly outperform long-form content across almost all categories, with consumer app reviews and scam-checking angles generating the highest view counts (e.g., Cashify, WeWard, Zocdoc).
